description:
"Imagine a platform called Arena Bet, tailored for esports fans who live and breathe League of Legends (LoL). It's all about creating a safe space where you can bet on your favorite LoL team. Here's what makes it special:

Smart Contracts: Our smart contracts automate everything, so payouts are fair and square based on match results. No middlemen, no worries.

Easy Access: Whether you're on your laptop or smartphone, our user-friendly interface makes betting a breeze. Browse the not started yet matches, make a bet and if your team won, claim the reward based on the total pool value divided by the winning pool bettors.
how_its_made:
Building Arena Bet involved integrating various technologies to create a robust platform for esports betting, here’s how we pieced it all together:

1. Riot Games API Integration:

Purpose: To fetch real-time match data from League of Legends.
Implementation: Utilized Riot Games API to retrieve match schedules, team compositions, player stats, and live game updates. This data forms the backbone of our platform, ensuring users have accurate and up-to-date information for placing bets.

2. Frontend Development with Next.js:

Purpose: Create a responsive and user-friendly interface for betting.
Implementation: The frontend integrates seamlessly with backend APIs and smart contracts to provide a cohesive user experience.

3. Partner Technologies:

Metamask: Connet easily with your metamask wallet to make your bets.

Deployment: Deployed on Arbitrum and Sepolia for the luxury of choice.

Blockscout: Verify all transactions data on Blockscout for seamless trust.
